A Few Things You May Wonder: A Few Things You May Wonder
FAQ introduction: From choosing your flowers to having them delivered, here are a few things worth knowing before you order.
Do I need an account to place an order?: Do I need an account to place an order?
FAQ guest checkout answer: No. You can browse flowers, add them to your cart, and place an order without signing in. At checkout, simply provide the required sender, recipient, and delivery information.
Can I send flowers to someone else?: Can I send flowers to someone else?
FAQ gifting answer: Yes. You can enter separate details for the person placing the order and the person receiving the flowers. If the flowers are for you, select ‘The orderer is also the recipient’.
Can I choose a delivery date and time sl: Can I choose a delivery date and time slot?
FAQ delivery schedule answer: Yes. You can select a delivery date and time slot during checkout. Available options depend on the delivery method and the time slots currently supported by the store.
How can I check whether delivery is avai: How can I check whether delivery is available in my area?
FAQ delivery area answer: During checkout, select your city or province and ward to check the available delivery areas. Delivery fees depend on the destination and selected delivery method. You can review the costs before confirming your order.
Can I include a card and a personal mess: Can I include a card and a personal message?
FAQ card message answer: Yes. During checkout, you can select a greeting card or message banner and write your message. The selected card option applies to the entire order.
Can I keep the sender's name anonymous?: Can I keep the sender's name anonymous?
FAQ anonymous sender answer: You can select ‘Keep sender anonymous’ when entering your order details. The store will still require the necessary contact information to process the order.
What payment methods does Lunarra curren: What payment methods does Lunarra currently accept?
FAQ payment answer: Cash on delivery (COD) is currently available. Bank transfer payments are not yet available for completing an order.
How can I track my flower order?: How can I track my flower order?
FAQ order tracking answer: After placing an order, save your order number. Visit the Order Tracking page, enter your order number along with the sender's or recipient's phone number, and complete verification to view the order information and progress.
